objective: Bring 5 Handfuls of Stardust to Pelturas in Astranaar.

description: Elune's Tear washed clear some of my daughter's sickness.  Her nightmares are lessened and I thank the goddess for her blessing.  But ... fever still rages within her.
Orendil told me of a frosted dust found among the Ruins of Stardust.  Perhaps it will abate Relara's fever.  Gather some of the dust, then please return to me.
The Ruins of Stardust lie to the south, <name>.  May Elune speed your journey.
progress: Do you yet have the Stardust, <name>?
completion: You gathered the dust! I will create a poultice from these -- it should bring down Relara's fever.
Thank you again, <name>. Without your help, my child would surely perish.
